svg.desc: Port Said Tunnels LOCATION Port Saied, Egypt CLIENT National Authority for Tunnels (NAT) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2015 4.5 Billion EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2015 for the National Authority for Tunnels, this 4.5 billion EGP project in Port Said involved the design of two road tunnels totaling 4 km under the Suez Canal, along with a feasibility study for a third railway tunnel. Services included architecture, structural and civil engineering, MEP, urban planning, environmental and social studies, and transportation and mobility studies.
